title: The Product Filter for WooCommerce by WBW plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Missing Authorization / Information…
description: The Product Filter for WooCommerce by WBW plugin for WordPress up to version 3.4.6 has a missing authorization vulnerability in its 'filtersFrontend' AJAX action. This flaw allows unauthenticated attackers to manipulate query parameters and enumerate non-public WooCommerce products, including drafts and pending items, and to perform unbounded queries that retrieve all products in a single request.
